> A one handed keyboard for gaming ( Valorant ). It has per-key RGB and is unlike some of my other projects, it is not battery powered, to save money. It is a mechanical keyboard with KMK and circuit python. I will be using quite a few left over / extra parts from week 4 so they will not be included in the BOM ( capacitors, resistors, level shifter ) and neither will the switches because I will buy them myself.

### 2026-11-06: I wrote the code for the gamepad. The keyboard is a 5x6 matrix with some spaces so there are only 27 keys. There is RGB and you can skip through or toggle on and off using some combos I made. The enco

**2.23h**

I wrote the code for the gamepad. The keyboard is a 5x6 matrix with some spaces so there are only 27 keys. There is RGB and you can skip through or toggle on and off using some combos I made. The encoder is not part of the matrix so it has its own pin for the pushbutton as well, and it controls volume and can also mute.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/35f84b10-f406-46c5-962a-2cad9054fc33/video.mp4)
